_comment: Map pack build settings. Paths are relative to the repo root. Second round (2026-11-15): packs go to data/map/packs-v2; the first round's packs in data/map/packs are left as they are.

clip._note: US Census TIGER/Line 2026 state polygons (public domain): the legal state areas including water (Lake Erie). The Geofabrik .poly outlines used in the first round are buffered by 0.4-1 km, so neighbouring packs overlapped. Written to data/map/work/clip-v2/<state>.geojson by census_clip.py.

build._java_heap_note: the first PA z0-15 build ran with 5g and peaked at 6.72 GiB working set; with 4g the process stays near the 6 GB budget (see docs/experiments/02-map.md)
build._landcover_note: false = feed the profile an empty landcover GeoPackage so no ESA WorldCover (CC-BY 4.0) data, and no extra credit line, ends up in the pack. The landcover layer only exists at z0-z7.

lanes._comment: Lane tags in the roads layer (profile patch, packbuilder/map/profile/). Only highway=motorway, trunk, primary and their links. Integers: lanes, lanes:forward, lanes:backward, lanes:both_ways. Strings as in OSM: turn:lanes, turn:lanes:forward, turn:lanes:backward, turn:lanes:both_ways. Lines with a direction-dependent value (:forward, :backward, turn:lanes) are not line-merged, so they keep the OSM way's direction (patch version 2).

_poi_drop_kinds_note: POI kinds left out when a variant has "poi_drop": true. Street furniture, trees, pedestrian crossings, railway switches and signals, cul-de-sac turning circles, parking spaces. Kept for driving: stop, give_way, traffic_signals, level_crossing, motorway_junction, parking, parking_entrance, fuel, charging_station and every shop, restaurant and other destination.

variants._comment: build_pack.py <state> --variant NAME. maxzoom; clamp = put the stock profile's z15-only POIs, house numbers and private roads into maxzoom; poi_drop = leave out poi_drop_kinds; buildings_detail_at_top = no merging of buildings at maxzoom; format = mvt or mlt (MapLibre Tiles, with optional Planetiler mlt_* flags); lanes = false leaves the lane tags out (for measuring their cost).

finish._comment: finish_pack.py, run by build_pack.py on Planetiler's output. Header bounds come from the clip polygon.
finish._remove_codepoints_note: Removed from every string in the tiles: everything above U+FFFF (emoji such as U+1F7E2 in Ohio trail names, Osage letters in Oklahoma place names), variation selectors U+FE00-FE0F and the zero-width joiner U+200D. The style bundle has glyph ranges for U+0000-FFFF only.
